property_summary: For any externally-observable call context (any msg.sender and any caller contract), calling C.owner() via a low-level call initiated by a caller contract returns the originally stored owner (the deployer) — the mutant returns tx.origin instead and thus will differ when the caller contract is invoked by an EOA different from the deployer; the test fuzzes the EOA caller so the mutant fails for some EOA values.
change_summary: owner() now returns tx.origin instead of the stored _owner, exposing the externally-owned originator as the owner.
